title: Prove a sharp two-occurrence terminal-widening budget bound
body:
## Summary

```text
PR2979 final words, fixed frames/gates/capacity pool
  + all 22 literal terminal paths in both providers
  + common exact price per widened occurrence
  + one-change fractional witnesses pass
  + any two changes among 14,652 occurrences fail
```

Add only `research/rank7-all-terminal-sensitivity/`. The complete-moment lower bound after two changes exceeds `1.000000000041`, even with arbitrary fractional repacking. Two is sharp in this relaxation, not a physical one-change construction. All nonempty uniform endpoint controls follow as a corollary.

PR3237 already rejects uniform widenings on V45's four endpoints. This adds nonuniform individual-call coverage across all five groups. No new kappa, supplier admission or selected-frontier change.

## Evidence

- Before: PR3237 covers 15 uniform V45 controls, not arbitrary individual-call choices across all 22 endpoints.
- After: both literal frame profiles, every endpoint delta, all 2,551 dual inequalities, and passing singleton primals are checked. Eleven behavioral groups include all 22 changed literal words, separate geometry/pattern oracles, semantic rejections and source-corruption failure.
- Registered CPython 3.12.15 replay, optimized CPython 3.13.5 checks, exact committed Git-free read-only-source export, Ruff and all 17 publication-byte comparisons pass locally. Replay planning selects only this package. Hosted CI is separate.

```sh
python3.12 -I -Werror -B scripts/research_package.py \
  --package research/rank7-all-terminal-sensitivity
```

Base is canonical `463113d675af7410ac91d53a4fed51ec6494eb9a`, priority revision 6, unchanged at submission refresh. All seven inputs resolve on canonical main, without foreign unmerged Git objects. Exact sources, environment, proof, receipt and open questions are committed.

Credit Marius-Paul Dumitrean/PR2979, commdata2338/PR3237, Jeremy Kothe, Mason Hale, Jeremy Diviney, the reused independent square-root arithmetic and the retained geometry/native/owner lineage. Substantial automated assistance was used; no independent human or proof-kernel review is claimed.

## Merge Danger

Door: two-way. One isolated opt-in package; frozen predecessors and shared tools are unchanged.

Blast Radius: research.

Native/scalar/dirty-state semantics, actual cleanup and backing/movement, precision/tape, bit-side certification, supplier/outer release and all-size/compiler obligations remain unrun. Original placement legality is not replayed here. The result rejects only fixed-word terminal widenings in the stated capacity model, not changed words, helper splitting/coding or changed consumer contracts.
